hint: An exponent counts how many times the base is used as a factor. It is not the base times the exponent.
explanation: The exponent $3$ means three factors of $5$ multiplied together: $5 \times 5 \times 5$.
Multiply the first two factors to make the work easier: $5 \times 5 = 25$.
Multiply that product by the last factor: $25 \times 5 = 125$.
So the value of the power $5^3$ is $125$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Common cube
steps: Think of a $5 \times 5 \times 5$ cube made of unit cubes.
